finding.expected: Redesign the CORRECTION_FRONTIER/UNIQUE_FINDING caller material so exact bounded finding semantics and lineage can be validated without requiring a full RESULT or EVIDENCE object per frontier item. Preserve exact outstanding-set matching, review/finding identity binding, fail-closed substitution behavior, and Brain selection authority. Add tests proving a frontier compiles from the minimum finding/lineage contract without per-item RESULT/EVIDENCE and still rejects missing, extra, duplicate, substituted, or cross-lineage findings.
finding.issue: CORRECTION_FRONTIER requires a full source RESULT for every outstanding finding solely so the compiler can revalidate the source REVIEW. TASK-178 r2 explicitly requires Minimum Necessary Context for correction authoring and says not to replicate RESULT/EVIDENCE per frontier item when the exact canonical finding contract and bounded lineage facts are sufficient. The emitted packet omits RESULT, but the compiler's typed input contract still makes every frontier item carry source_result, so the deterministic support surface demands materially more canonical context than the r2 contract allows and scales that excess with frontier size.

original_constraints: AIOS_DECISION_PACKET v1 remains one deterministic, read-only, provider-neutral envelope for exactly one selected semantic decision and supports exactly the existing six BP-3 flows: ARCHITECTURE, TASK_AUTHORING, SEMANTIC_REVIEW, REMEDIATION_AUTHORING, REPAIR_AUTHORING and DIAGNOSTIC. NONE, unknown flows, unknown payload kinds and packet nesting fail closed.

Keep canonical facts, bounded observations, Executor claims, prior semantic decisions and current Human input in distinct information classes. RESULT claims remain Executor claims; REVIEW/REMEDIATION/REPAIR remain prior semantic decisions; Human text cannot overwrite canonical subject/provenance/authority. The compiler creates no verdict, hypothesis, correction choice, Executor choice, lifecycle action, publication action or roadmap decision.

Do not modify files outside scope.modify. If satisfying this contract requires changing Unified State, Correction Frontier, Flow Resolver, transport/publication contracts, correction dispatch/approval authority, provider surfaces or frozen Kernel semantics, fail closed back to Brain rather than widening scope.
